circle.data-description: HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (no input power), Solid Green (fan is functioning normal), Solid Amber (fan is abnormal, service is required)

circle.data-states: off ok fail standby fw-update input-lost warning
circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no input power to all power supplies), Green (output ON and OK), Blinking Green 1/sec (standby state, only +5VSB on), Blinking Green 2/sec (power supply firmware updating, boot-loader mode), Red (critical event causing a shutdown - failure, over current, short circuit, over voltage, fan failure, over temperature), Blinking Red 1/sec (input power cord unplugged or input power lost with a second supply still fed), Blinking between Green and Red (warning while still operating - high temp, high power, high current, slow fan)
